solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Conservative forte at end of day unclear

parts.note: forte, in music, means loud

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, taken from day

explanation.surface: A political report: the Tory party is strong by close of play, but the outlook is murky.
explanation.definitionFit: Murky liquid or a vague idea can both be described as lacking clarity in this way.

clue.text: Movement of money remains fluid in firm given direction

indicators.note: the remains and the fluid sit inside the word for firm

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
ash is what remains after burning
W, west, is a compass direction

explanation.surface: A firm moves its funds, which are still liquid, under instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: The flow of money in and out of a business is its stream of cash.

clue.text: Emperor in love with America becomes demanding

indicators.note: the emperor sits inside the other pieces

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O
Nero was a Roman emperor

explanation.surface: A Roman emperor falls for America and turns needy.
explanation.definitionFit: A burdensome task is exacting, needing great effort.

clue.text: Girl made grand in swindle over small amount

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat them
O is the cricket abbreviation for over
a little is a small amount

explanation.surface: A young woman made rich by a con involving a pittance.
explanation.walkthrough: Eliza, the flower girl in Shaw's Pygmalion and My Fair Lady, is groomed into a grand lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Eliza of that surname is the Cockney girl turned into a lady by Henry Higgins.

clue.text: Yankee eccentric in burning American plane

indicators.note: one pair of pieces sits inside the word for burning

parts.note: a burning wound is sore
Yankee is Y in the NATO phonetic alphabet
an eccentric is a cam, an off-centre wheel in machinery

explanation.surface: An odd Yankee aboard a burning US aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plane' is the tree, not the aircraft; in North America the plane tree is called by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Americans give this name to the Platanus tree that Britons call the plane, so it is the American term for that tree.

clue.text: Dray horses like running free in upland location

indicators.note: horses running free are loose, and so are these letters

explanation.surface: Carthorses love galloping unbridled in the hills.
explanation.walkthrough: The Yorkshire Dales are a hilly national park in northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: This area of valleys and moorland in northern England is high country.

clue.text: Mission accomplished — like another mission — on all fronts!

indicators.note: the fronts of the words are their first letters

explanation.surface: A war report: the operation is done, just like the last one, everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The Alamo was a Spanish mission in Texas, famous for its 1836 siege.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alamo was built as a Franciscan religious outpost in San Antonio, Texas.

clue.text: In theory, paid for by The Times?

definitions.meaning: in theory means as planned, not yet tested in practice
funded by a newspaper, read literally

explanation.surface: A puzzle about who funds things: theoretically the newspaper pays.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means hypothetically; read literally it means funded by a newspaper.

clue.text: Erstwhile editor with artist making room for discussion

parts.note: erstwhile means former, ex
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A former editor and a painter are making space for a debate.
explanation.definitionFit: An exedra was a hall or recess with seats, used in ancient Greece for conversation.

clue.text: Rage in The Iliad troubled influential writer

indicators.note: troubled letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: The anger in Homer's Iliad bothered a great author.
explanation.definitionFit: The Florentine poet of the Divine Comedy shaped Italian literature for centuries.

clue.text: Reptile displays pride in Tarsus recklessly

indicators.note: the word for pride goes inside the rearranged town name
done recklessly, the letters of Tarsus are thrown about

parts.note: pride, self-esteem, is the ego

explanation.surface: A creature showing off with a swagger in the ancient city of Tarsus.
explanation.walkthrough: Tarsus, St Paul's birthplace, is only fodder; 'recklessly' scrambles it so the pride can sit inside.
explanation.definitionFit: This plated dinosaur was a prehistoric reptile, one of the best known.

clue.text: Small portion without starter's more than enough

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for a small portion is removed

parts.note: a small portion taken to try something is a sample

explanation.surface: A tiny serving with no appetiser is still a generous meal, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starter' refers to the first letter, not a first course.
explanation.definitionFit: Something plentiful is abundant, comfortably exceeding what is needed.

clue.text: Trader, Asian native in no hurry to plug financial publication

indicators.note: the animal fills the gap in the newspaper's initials as a plug fills a hole

parts.note: FT is the Financial Times
the slow loris is a sluggish primate native to Asia

explanation.surface: A leisurely Asian businessman promoting the Financial Times.
explanation.walkthrough: The Financial Times is a London business daily, known as the FT.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sells flowers is a shopkeeper, a kind of trader.

clue.text: Cork spokesman's initial remark surpassing others

indicators.note: the initial of a word is its first letter, here of spokesman's

parts.note: a remark that caps everyone else's is a topper

explanation.surface: A press officer in the Irish city of Cork makes the best opening comment.
explanation.walkthrough: Cork looks like the Irish city; it is the bung in a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A cork is a bung that seals a bottle, a plug of this kind.

clue.text: Working class making start

parts.note: a machine that is working is on
a class of pupils grouped by ability is a set

explanation.surface: The working class is getting going.
explanation.definitionFit: The beginning of something, such as an illness, is its commencement.

clue.text: Daughter leaving waterside in distress, so to speak

indicators.note: distressed letters are battered into a new order
the daughter departs from the word, so her letter is removed

explanation.surface: A girl walks away from the riverbank in tears, to put it that way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' takes D out of WATERSIDE, and 'in distress' rearranges WATERSIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases are idioms used to mark a figurative or loose way of putting something.

clue.text: Militarist marines ahead in punt

indicators.note: the marines and ahead go inside the word for punt

parts.note: a punt is a bet, a wager
RM stands for the Royal Marines
on means ahead, as in getting on

explanation.surface: Marines leading the way in a flat-bottomed boat look warlike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punt' looks like the boat; it is a bet.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who stirs up war is a hawk, an advocate of military force.

clue.text: Ruler agonising over northern part

indicators.note: only part of the run of words is used, a stretch in the middle

explanation.surface: A leader worrying over the north of the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A colonial or state governor rules a territory, so is a kind of ruler.

clue.text: Force one to have home and family life

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for force in physics
one is I as a Roman numeral
to have one's home somewhere is to reside there

explanation.surface: Being forced to have a house and a family.
explanation.definitionFit: The hearth stands for the home, so a figurative sense covers domestic life with relatives.

clue.text: Irish cardinal collecting silver for a time

indicators.note: the number gathers the metal inside it

parts.note: a cardinal number such as one
AG is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: An Irish cardinal gathers silver for a while.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cardinal' is a number, not a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: This prehistoric period, after the Bronze one, is an era or age.

clue.text: Copy material crook regularly supplied

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric used in upholstery

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals from crook gives every other one

explanation.surface: A swindler routinely delivered fake goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A reproduction is a copy, often of furniture or art, shortened in trade talk.

clue.text: Job description has worker keeping allegiance, under pressure

indicators.note: in a down answer, the rest sits beneath the pressure letter

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure

indicators.note: the insect holds the bond within it

parts.note: a worker ant
a tie is a bond or allegiance

explanation.surface: An employee under strain who keeps a loyal bond to the firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Job' is the biblical Job, famed for long-suffering endurance, not a post.
explanation.definitionFit: Job's proverbial endurance makes this word the description of him.

clue.text: Princess is no spring chicken, last in line

parts.note: someone no spring chicken is old

indicators.note: last in a word is its final letter, from line

explanation.surface: A royal who is past her youth stands at the back of the queue.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolde is the Irish princess of the Tristan legend.

clue.text: Bear cat in bag hunter's opening

indicators.note: the cat goes inside the word for bag

parts.note: a sac is a bag-like pouch in a body
a tom is a male cat

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, from hunter's

explanation.surface: A hunter starts by stuffing a bear and a cat into a sack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bear' is the verb meaning tolerate, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: To be able to tolerate something is to put up with it, a verb sense of both words.

clue.text: A set of books taking in extremely gullible representative

indicators.note: the outer pieces take the gullible's ends inside

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a set of books

indicators.note: extremely means the outer letters of gullible

explanation.surface: An accountant with a set of books cons a very naive rep.
explanation.definitionFit: An agent acts on behalf of someone else, representing them.

clue.text: Judas for one bitter, perhaps, about situation

indicators.note: the beer goes around the word for situation

parts.note: bitter is an example of ale, a British beer
a situation or job is a post

explanation.surface: Judas, say, may be bitter about his position.
explanation.walkthrough: Bitter is a hoppy British draught beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve disciples sent out by Jesus.

clue.text: Withdraw permission

definitions.meaning: to withdraw is to go away or depart
permission, as in being given time off or allowed to do something

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: depart, and the noun for authorised absence.

clue.text: Laurel for instance always an environmentalist

parts.note: always means ever, as in ever-ready
an environmentalist is a Green

explanation.surface: Someone forever an eco-campaigner wears a laurel wreath.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurel keeps its leaves all year, so it is an example of such a plant.

clue.text: Chosen people, endlessly wealthy, driven by power

parts.note: the elect are those chosen, as by God

indicators.note: without its end, the word for wealthy loses its final letter

parts.note: wealthy means rich

explanation.surface: An elite of rich people relentlessly pursuing power.
explanation.definitionFit: A car or train powered from the mains or a battery runs on current.

clue.text: Breadwinner finally comes in to provide food bowl

indicators.note: the letter enters the word for providing food

parts.note: to provide food is to cater

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of Breadwinner

explanation.surface: The wage-earner turns up at last with something to eat in a dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A hollow made by a volcano or impact is bowl-shaped.
